keyPoints.en: Semibreve 4, minim 2, crotchet 1, quaver ½, semiquaver ¼. A dot adds half the value.
keyPoints.bm: Semibrif 4, minim 2, krocet 1, kuaver ½, semikuaver ¼. Titik menambah separuh nilai.

keyPoints.en: Each rest has the same value as its matching note.
keyPoints.bm: Setiap tanda rehat mempunyai nilai yang sama dengan notnya.

keyPoints.en: Stave: 5 lines, 4 spaces. Treble clef lines E G B D F; spaces F A C E.
keyPoints.bm: Baluk: 5 garisan, 4 ruang. Garisan klef trebel E G B D F; ruang F A C E.

keyPoints.en: Bass clef lines G B D F A; spaces A C E G.
keyPoints.bm: Garisan klef bes G B D F A; ruang A C E G.

keyPoints.en: Time signature: top number = beats per bar. 2/4 march, 3/4 waltz, 4/4 common time.
keyPoints.bm: Meter: nombor atas = detik setiap bar. 2/4 kawad, 3/4 waltz, 4/4 meter biasa.

keyPoints.en: Major scale: T T S T T T S; solfa do re mi fa so la ti do.
keyPoints.bm: Skel major: T T S T T T S; solfa do re mi fa so la ti do.

tip.en: Always add up the beats in each bar.
tip.bm: Sentiasa jumlahkan detik dalam setiap bar.
